This is the kind of cake where kids can jump in, sprinkle freely, arrange the patterns, and proudly say, “I made this.” 💛 #cakedecorating #BirthdayCakeIdeas #FoodiesofSACakeDecoratingSeries #NestleChocolates #NestleSmarties  TOTAL TIME: 1 HR 15 MINS PREP-TIME: 15 MINS COOK TIME: 1 HOUR LEVEL: EASY INGREDIENTS 2 boxes (600g each) vanilla flavoured cake mix (and all ingredients required for the box mix) 6 boxes (40g each) Nestlé Smarties Chocolate 1 tub store-bought chocolate icing METHOD 1. Preheat oven and prepare two 23cm cake pans by spraying with non-stick spray and lining with baking paper. Alternatively bake the mix as cupcakes. 2. Mix the cake batter per the box instructions. Chop 1 box of Nestlé Smarties Chocolate and gently fold it into the cake batter. Pour the batter into the prepared cake pans or cupcake papers and bake. Allow to cool completely on a wire rack, then refrigerate until firm, approximately 1 hour. 3. Take a small cutter or object, like a mug or bowl, to mark a circle in the exact center of both cakes. Using a sharp knife, cut out and remove the center piece from both cakes, leaving you with two large cake rings. *Chef's tip: alternatively use a bundt cake tin 4. Divide each cake ring into four quarters. Remove the top-right quarter from the first ring and the bottom-right quarter from the second ring. 5. Look at the inner edges of the remaining two large 'C' shapes. Trim a very small, crescent-shaped piece off the inner edge of both C-shapes where they will meet in the middle to form the figure-eight. This ensures the two main pieces can touch and join cleanly. 6. Carefully arrange the two large C-shaped pieces onto a serving board, pushing the trimmed edges together in the center to form the number '3'. 7. Apply a thin layer of the store-bought chocolate icing all over the cake to seal any crumbs. Chill for 15 minutes. Then, apply a smooth, thick, and even second layer of icing over the entire surface of the assembled number cake. This acts as the "glue" for the Smarties decoration. 8. Sort the remaining whole Smarties by colour. Starting at the edges, lay the whole Smarties onto the iced cake in neat rows or distinct color lines. Press each Smartie gently into the icing to secure the colourful, patterned finish. Alternatively, arrange the cupcakes in a number 3 shape, ice to join the cupcakes together and decorate with Smarties. 9. Refrigerate the decorated cake for at least 15 minutes to allow the icing to set and the Smarties to adhere firmly. 10. When ready, use a sharp knife to slice and serve this fun, festive Smarties Celebration Confetti Cake, and ENJOY!

Try the recipe below: Ingredients: 3 1⁄2 packets Oreo biscuits, about 49 cookies 500g fresh cream 1 tbsp. YUM YUM peanut butter 150g condensed milk 2 knobs Melted butter 6 pieces chocolate chopped Method: 1. Line a square baking dish with parchment paper. 2. Add the Oreos to a zip lock bag and smack them with a rolling pin until finely crushed. 3. In a bowl add crushed biscuits with melted butter, mix together until a crumbly mixture is formed. 4. Pour half of the Oreo mixture into the square dish, spread evenly and press down using the glass. 5. Place the pan into the freezer while you prepare the ice cream. In a separate bowl: 1. Use an electric hand mixer to beat heavy cream until it becomes stiff peaks, add in YUM YUM peanut butter and whisk again. 2. Slowly pour the condensed milk, crushed biscuits and chocolate and fold together until combined. 3. Remove the square dish from the freeze and pour the ice cream mixture onto the crust and spread out evenly. 4. Freeze for 3 hours. 5. Add the remaining Oreo crumbs on top of the ice cream mixture, use the glass to press the mixture very gently so it sticks. 6. Freeze over night. 7. Cut into squares. One tray. Big flavour. Minimal effort. 🙌 Our Chakalaka Sausage Bake with Fry’s Classic Sizzlers is the ultimate weeknight or weekend winner – hearty, colourful, and ready in just 35 minutes. Method: 1. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celcius. 2. Place the vegetables into an oven proof roasting dish and drizzle with olive oil, season, then pour the can of chakalaka into the roasting dish with the vegetables and mix thoroughly. 3. Place the Fry’s Sizzlers on top of the chakalaka vegetables and put the roasting dish into the oven, and bake off for 30 minutes, turning the sausages halfway. 4. Remove the tray from the oven – sprinkle with fresh chopped herbs (Parsley, chives or coriander work well here) and serve with phuthu, rice or mash. *Tip: If you’d like this sausage bake a little saucier – pour 1 Cup of Vegetable stock over the vegetables at halfway. #FrysFamily #PlantBased #EasyRecipes #FlexiForward #FoodWithFlexAppeal

These Indian-spiced minced meat & peas samosas are the perfect balance of crunch and spice, made effortlessly with East End’s finest spices. ✨ Here’s how to make them: 🌿 Ingredients: • 250g minced lamb • 1 small onion, finely chopped • 1 tsp East End Cumin Seeds • 1 tsp East End Garam Masala • ½ tsp East End Turmeric Powder • 1 tsp East End Coriander Powder • ½ tsp East End Chilli Powder (adjust to taste) • ½ tsp salt • 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste • 50g green peas • 1 tbsp fresh coriander, chopped • 1 tbsp oil • 1 pack of samosa pastry sheets • Water for sealing • Oil for frying 🥄 Method: 1️⃣ Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan, add East End Cumin Seeds, and let them sizzle. Add chopped onions and sauté until golden. 2️⃣ Stir in ginger-garlic paste and minced meat. Cook until browned. 3️⃣ Add East End Garam Masala, Turmeric, Coriander Powder, Chilli Powder, and salt. Mix well. 4️⃣ Stir in green peas and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool. Mix in fresh coriander. 5️⃣ Take a samosa pastry sheet, fold into a triangle, and fill with 1-2 tbsp of the mixture. Seal with flour paste. 6️⃣ Deep-fry until crispy and golden. Drain on kitchen paper. Serve hot with East End Green Chilli Sauce or East End Tamarind Sauce!  Who’s ready to try these? 🙌 #samosas #keemasamosa #samosarecipe #homemadesamosa #eastend #garammasala

Split the vanilla pod and scrape the seeds into a pan with the cream. Toss the pod in too. Heat until just before the cream boils, tiny bubbles will be forming at the edges. Turn off the heat and infuse for 15 mins. Step 2 Divide the raspberries between the ramekins, reserving a few. Whisk the egg yolks and caster sugar, until very pale and fluffy, about 3 mins. Remove the vanilla pod from the cooled cream, then slowly stir it into the egg mixture. Transfer to a jug and pour into the ramekins, then top with the reserved raspberries. Place ramekins into a tray with water about halfway up the sides. Bake in the oven for 20-25 mins until the custard forms a skin and holds a slight wobble when you nudge the tray. Allow to cool, then chill in the fridge for at least 4 hrs. Step 4 If you don’t have a blowtorch, heat the grill to high. Sprinkle sugar over each ramekin in an even layer and either use a blowtorch to caramelise the top or place them under the grill until the sugar has melted and crisped. 🧬 Addiction isn’t a choice. It’s a disease. For decades, society has told us that addiction is a matter of willpower - that people should “just stop.” But modern genetics and neuroscience tell a very different story. There are over 270 genes that increase the risk of developing Alcohol Use Disorder. Combine that with trauma, mental health struggles, and constant exposure to alcohol in our culture — and what you get isn’t a lack of discipline. It’s biology. 🧠 Addiction rewires the brain. Made with simple pantry staples, it's an easy yet delicious treat to share with family and friends.     Ingredients:   🥛 2 ½ cups East End Milk Powder   🍚 ⅔ cup sugar   🧁 1 tbsp baking powder   🥚 3 eggs   🌿 ¼ cup vegetable oil   🥛 Dashes of milk (as needed), Caramel Sauce or Dulce De Leche  Method: 1️⃣ Toast the milk powder – Lightly toast the milk powder in a pan for a few minutes, making sure to keep stirring to prevent clumping and burning. Remove from the stove. 2️⃣ Combine dry ingredients – mix the toasted milk powder, baking powder, and sugar until well combined.   3️⃣ Whisk wet ingredients – In a separate bowl, beat the eggs, oil, and a dash of milk until smooth.   4️⃣ Mix together – Gradually add the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, stirring until a batter forms. Add more milk if needed to get a better consistency.   5️⃣ Bake – Pour the batter into a greased cake tin and use a spoon to flatten the thick cake batter to fit into the cake tin. Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.   6️⃣ Let it cool before adding the caramel sauce. Slice then enjoy this soft and fluffy Eid treat!     Would you make this for your Eid celebrations? Leftovers never looked this good 😋Turn your holiday turkey into Creamy Poblano Turkey Enchiladas topped with rich, authentic LALA Crema Mexicana. Because when you deck the table with LALA, every bite feels like home. ❤️   #DeckTheTable #LALACremaMexicana #HolidayLeftovers #AuthenticFlavor Recipe ⬇️  Ingredients: 2 tbsps butter 2 poblano peppers, chopped Minced garlic 1/4 cup flour 11/4 cup chicken broth 11/4 cup heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp onion powder 1 tsp salt 1 cup cilantro, diced 2 cups left over turkey 1-4oz cans hatch green chilis, diced 2 cups Colby jack cheese, shredded Corn tortillas Sauce: 1. Place butter into pan on medium heat and let melt. Then add in chopped up poblano peppers to sauté for about 5 min. 2. Once softened add in minced garlic and cook for 2 min. Then add in flour and slow mix together for additional 3 min. 3. Then add in chicken broth and mix well. Once the sauce thickens, transfer it to another bowl and blend together with an immersion blender. (Could also use a regular blender) 4. Transfer sauce back to pan and once it comes to a simmer add in heavy whipping cream, salt, onion powder, cilantro and mix well. Enchiladas Filling: In a bowl mix turkey, Colby jack cheese, and green hatch chilis Assemble Enchiladas and sprinkle shredded cheese on top. Place in the oven at 375 for 15min until cheese is melted. Pro tip: place corn tortillas in microwave wrapped in a towel for about 30 seconds to softened them so they don’t tear when assembling enchiladas.

It’s #valentinesday with @Australian Eggs! So here’s my #recipefromtheheart - Mini rose Basque cheesecakes with rose cream and rose syrup topping! They’re easy, SO pretty and the perfect way to celebrate love with EVERYONE you care for. #joyfulfood #eggrecipes  RECIPE:  Cheesecake ingredients:  - 500g cream cheese, room temperature - 1 cup thickened cream - ½ cup caster sugar - ½ tsp salt - ½ tsp vanilla extract  - ¼ cup plain flour - 3 eggs - hint of pink food colouring (optional, look for natural) - ½ tsp rose essence  Rose syrup:  - 1 cup caster sugar - 1 cup water - pink food colour - 1 tsp rose water Rose cream topping:  - 1 cup thickened cream - 1 Tbsp caster sugar  - pink food colour  - 1 tsp rose essence  METHOD:  - First make your rose syrup; simmering together the water and caster sugar until dissolved and slightly thickened. - Allow to cool completely, then stir in a drop of two of pink food colouring and 1 tsp rose water. Keep chilled until needed. Keeps for 4 weeks in the fridge and makes a perfect addition to cocktails too! - Pre-heat your oven to 220C (fan forced). And line a cupcake or muffin tin with baking papers or patty cases for 18 mini cheesecakes — you can do batches.   In a stand mixer with a paddle or with electric beaters, whip the cream cheese until smooth. Add in the cream and mix lightly. Then add the sugar, salt, and vanilla extract, beating until you cannot feel any sugar granules when you rub the mix between your fingers.  - Sprinkle the flour over the batter and mix in the eggs one at a time, beating lightly after each addition to incorporate, then add the rose essence and mix, before swirling in a little pink food colour.  - Pour the batter into the prepared tin and bake on the middle shelf for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheesecakes look almost burnt on the outside, this is the signature caramelisation.  - Allow to cool completely, or chill in the fridge.  - Meanwhile, whip the cream, caster sugar and rose essence and swirl in a few drops of pink food colouring.  - To serve, top each mini cheesecake with a swirl of rose cream, a scattering of rose petals, pistachio and fairy floss and a drizzle of rose syrup.
